note: Three ways in, how to get there **without a product background**, and **who is hiring** in India right now.

roleTypes.name: Associate product manager (APM)
roleTypes.what: The standard way in. A rotational programme at big companies, a direct hire everywhere else.

roleTypes.name: Product intern
roleTypes.what: 8–12 weeks on a small piece of a live product. Often the fast track into the full-time APM job.

roleTypes.name: Product analyst
roleTypes.what: Owns the data a product manager uses. Doesn't own the roadmap, but sits one move away from it.
